# Preparing to Add the First Route

#### Course: React Beyond Basics

## Preparing to Add the First Route

Let's set up our first route. First, install react-router-dom:

```react
npm install react-router-dom
```

However, we've already listed react-router-dom inside package.json:

![Component Rendering with Router](data:application/octet-stream;base64,)

So, you don't need to install it as long as you're coding on our Programiz IDE platform.

All you need to do is import from it directly in your component files.
